expected.title: Nilpotent Faber–Krahn and Weyl asymptotic nodal-domain bound for closed equiregular sub-Riemannian manifolds
expected.author: Rupert L. Frank; Bernard Helffer
expected.difficulty_reason: Nilpotent pointwise models do not directly control small nodal domains uniformly across a varying sub-Riemannian manifold. The authors establish uniform energy comparison and continuity of the local Faber–Krahn constants, then use a controlled IMS partition to obtain a small-volume inequality involving their integrated density rather than a coarse infimum. Together with the new Sobolev nodal restriction, that local-to-global estimate supplies the nonroutine part of the nodal count beyond the precise prior kernel/Weyl foundations.
